newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns Toshiba "A" long-term rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Toshiba "A" long-term rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Monday that it had assigned its single A long-term corporate credit rating to Toshiba Corp.

S&P also said in a statement that it had assigned its single A long-term issue rating to the joint $1 billion Euro medium-term note programme of Toshiba and its financial subsidiary, Toshiba International Finance (Netherland) B.V.
It said the outlook for the ratings was stable.
The ratings reflect Toshiba's diverse range of businesses, including particularly strong positions in notebook computers, semiconductors and heavy electrical apparatuses, S&P said.

It said Toshiba's earnings from semiconductor operations are expected to decline significantly in fiscal 1996/97 as a result of a severe market downturn, but this should be partially offset by increasing exports of notebook computers, fuelled by strong demand for the firm's notebooks worldwide.

S&P added that further reductions in debt and increased control over capital investment through strategic alliances should offset the impact on Toshiba's credit rating of increased competition and reliance on cyclical and capital-intensive business.
